question: Accept the DEV-80 shape (runner seam skill-runner.sh with cloud primary and bare fallback, forge-skill-scenarios/v1 per-skill file, three Phase 4 report fields, AC-1 falsifier already red on the current tree) and admit build? artifacts.summary: Shape delivered all three dispatch linchpins: a four-row trap table binding each runner design choice to measured evidence; the scenario format with the three DEV-80 scenarios written in full and the adversarial property required; the AC-1 falsifier exercised two-sided (exit 1 with four violations on the current tree across both Phase 2 run paths, exit 0 on the intended wording). Two measurements changed the design: parallel-forge.md is a second in-session run path, and the bare runner carries no --model pin. Stop numbers: 14 files, 700 lines, 180 lines in skill-runner.sh. Open for the Captain: runner credentials are machine-local; default is fail loudly and record which runner ran. Residual: skill-scenarios/ is outside the sanitize-check glob; the slice extends it by two lines.
